name: Jesse Burch
biography: Jesse Burch (born Jesse E. Johnson; September 2, 1970) is an American actor. He has been featured in many video games, animated series, and TV and radio commercials. He started his career working on-camera and has appeared in over fifty national commercials, many television shows, and fifteen feature films.
